question: Let $a,b,c$ be real numbers. Then the fourth degree polynomial in $x$, $acx^4+b(a+c)x^3+(a^2+b^2+c^2)x^2+b(a+c)x+ac$

options.B: has either four real roots or four complex roots
options.C: has two real roots and two complex roots

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
